domains.title: Brand domains (one per line)
domains.description: The domains you want to protect, e.g. stripe.com, mycompany.io. The actor generates lookalike variants of each and checks which are registered.

includeHomoglyphs.title: Include homoglyph tricks
includeHomoglyphs.description: Also test look-alike character swaps like o->0, l->1, rn->m, vv->w. These are the sneakiest impersonations.

extraTlds.title: Extra TLDs to test (optional)
extraTlds.description: Additional top-level domains to check the exact brand name against, e.g. shop, store, ai. A common set is always included.

onlyWithMx.title: Only mail-capable lookalikes
onlyWithMx.description: Return only registered lookalikes that have a mail server, meaning they can send brand-spoofing email. The highest-risk subset.

includeRegistrationDate.title: Look up registration date
includeRegistrationDate.description: Add each lookalike's domain registration date via RDAP so you can spot recently registered threats. Adds one lookup per lookalike found.

maxVariantsPerDomain.title: Max variants per domain
maxVariantsPerDomain.description: How many lookalike candidates to generate and check per brand domain. Higher = more thorough, more DNS lookups.

maxRows.title: Max lookalikes per run
maxRows.description: Cap on registered lookalike rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip lookalikes seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned lookalikes across runs and skip them. Turn on with a schedule to be alerted only when a NEW lookalike of your brand appears.
